effects: Pulls exactly `assets` USDC from the signer into the vault (safeTransferFrom in enter).
Mints vault shares (grove-bbqUSDC) to `onBehalf`. The number is previewDeposit(assets), worked out on chain from the share price after fees accrue.
Spends the signer's USDC allowance to the vault by `assets`.
formats.shown: Deposit an exact USDC amount into the grove-bbqUSDC vault, with shares sent to onBehalf. The number of shares is not shown.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares minted is not shown because the contract computes it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol deposit: `uint256 shares = previewDeposit(assets);` comes from the vault's state, and no calldata holds a minimum. Case 0: the signer received 0.01 grove-bbqUSDC, and the screen gives only the ticker.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The function takes no minimum-shares parameter.

cases.notes: The screen shows the 0.01 USDC going out exactly. It names the shares (grove-bbqUSDC, sent to the signer) but cannot give their amount, which comes from the contract.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Burns vault shares from `onBehalf`. The number is previewWithdraw(assets), worked out on chain.
Sends exactly `assets` USDC from the vault to `receiver`.
When the signer is not onBehalf, uses up the share allowance that onBehalf gave the signer.
formats.shown: Withdraw exactly a given USDC amount to the receiver, with shares taken from the owner. The number of shares burned is not shown.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned is not shown because the contract computes it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol withdraw: `uint256 shares = previewWithdraw(assets);` and then deleteShares(onBehalf, shares). Case 2: 4989.82 grove-bbqUSDC left the signer, and the screen gives no share amount.
findings.fix: None possible. There is no max-shares parameter.

cases.notes: The 5000 USDC to the signer is shown exactly. The reader understood that shares are burned but could not see how many.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address onBehalf)
effects: Sends USDC from the vault to `receiver`. The amount is previewRedeem(shares), worked out on chain.
When the signer is not onBehalf, uses up the share allowance that onBehalf gave the signer.
formats.shown: Redeem an exact number of grove-bbqUSDC shares to the receiver, with the owner shown. The asset paid out (USDC) and its amount are not shown.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol exit: `SafeERC20Lib.safeTransfer(asset, receiver, assets);`. Case 3: 10000.02091 USDC went to the signer. The screen fields are only 'Shares to redeem', 'To' and 'Owner'. The reader wrote 'likely USDC, not shown'. The mint format already shows `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`.
findings.fix: Add a field like {label:'Receive asset', format:'raw', value:'$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker'}, and change interpolatedIntent to 'Redeem {#.shares} for USDC to {#.receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem: the USDC amount paid out is not shown because the contract computes it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol redeem: `uint256 assets = previewRedeem(shares);`, with no minimum-assets parameter. Case 3: 10000.02091 USDC came in.

cases.notes: The shares going out are shown exactly. The reader guessed the payout was USDC, but the screen names no asset and no amount.

effects: Pulls USDC from the signer into the vault. The amount is previewMint(shares), worked out on chain and rounded up.
Spends the signer's USDC allowance to the vault.
formats.shown: Mint an exact number of grove-bbqUSDC shares to onBehalf, with USDC as the deposit asset. The amount of USDC paid is not shown.

findings.title: mint: the USDC the signer pays is not shown because the contract computes it.
findings.evidence: VaultV2.sol mint: `uint256 assets = previewMint(shares);` and then safeTransferFrom(asset, msg.sender, ...). Case 1: 1.013972 USDC left the signer, and the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: USDC'.
findings.fix: None possible. There is no max-assets parameter.

findings.title: mint: the intent says 'Mint' and the sentence never says the signer pays USDC.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: intent 'Mint', interpolatedIntent 'Mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'. Case 1 screen: 'Mint 0.999999999 grove-bbqUSDC for 0x...dEaD'. Only a separate raw field says 'Deposit asset: USDC'.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Deposit' and interpolatedIntent 'Deposit USDC to mint {#.shares} for {#.onBehalf}'.

cases.notes: The reader knew USDC leaves but not how much. The contract computes that amount, so no field can show it. The shares going to 0xdead are stated plainly.
